Recency is tracked by ordering: most recently\n    used last.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, capacity, ttl=None, clock=time.monotonic):\n        if capacity < 1:\n            raise ValueError(\"capacity must be >= 1\")\n        self.capacity = capacity\n        self.ttl = ttl\n        self.clock = clock\n        self._data = OrderedDict()  # key -> (value, expiry_or_None)\n\n    def _expiry_for_new_entry(self):\n        if self.ttl is None:\n            return None\n        return self.clock() + self.ttl\n\n    def _is_expired(self, entry):\n        expiry = entry[1]\n        return expiry is not None and self.clock() >= expiry\n\n    def _purge_expired(self):\n        if self.ttl is None:\n            return\n        expired = [key for key, entry in self._data.items() if self._is_expired(entry)]\n        for key in expired:\n            del self._data[key]\n\n    def get(self, key, default=None):\n        entry = self._data.get(key)\n        if entry is None:\n            return default\n        if self._is_expired(entry):\n            del self._data[key]\n            return default\n        self._data.move_to_end(key)\n        return entry[0]\n\n    def put(self, key, value):\n        self._purge_expired()\n        self._data[key] = (value, self._expiry_for_new_entry())\n        self._data.move_to_end(key)\n        while len(self._data) > self.capacity:\n            self._data.popitem(last=False)\n\n    def __len__(self):\n        self._purge_expired()\n        return len(self._data)\n\n    def __contains__(self, key):\n        entry = self._data.get(key)\n        if entry is None:\n            return False\n        if self._is_expired(entry):\n            del self._data[key]\n            return True  # placeholder, replaced below\n        return True\n"}"]]}
